source_text:
3.24 Ἀφρικανοῦ· πρὸς δῆγμα παντὸς θηρίου Κάρδαμον λειώσας ἐπίπλασσε
μετὰ ὀθονίου ἢ τούτου σπέρμα βρέξας καὶ λειώσας ὡσαύτως ἐπιτίθει μετὰ ὀθονίου.
pass_a_gloss: 3.24 Of-Africanus: toward a-bite of-every beast. Cress having-pounded plaster with a-linen or of-this seed having-soaked and having-pounded likewise set-on with a-linen.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus: toward a bite of every beast. Pound cress and plaster it with a linen cloth; or soak the seed of this and pound it, and likewise set it on with a linen cloth.

choices.english: toward a bite of every beast
choices.why: παντὸς θηρίου is every wild beast, not 'the whole animal's bite'.
rejected: a bite of the whole hunt

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
